correctness.rationale: Each oriented graph-edge reversal is valid iff no second directed path joins endpoints. Alternating block representation then implies degree Σs_i s_{i+1}, a checked nonnegative degree-minus-d identity, exhaustive counts of even/odd simple block patterns, a case analysis that every legal flip of a simple orientation creates an interior nonsingleton block, and exact two-/three-block maximum degree. The poly-Bernoulli lower bound establishes balanced vanishing. Independently implemented orientation-DAG and nested-matrix enumerators verify test ranges.
